section.content: 本发明公开了一种用于接收串行传输数据的半导体集成电路。该电路在接收串行传输数据时，即使在串行传输数据因传输线路中信号出现延迟偏差而相对于采样时钟信号出现相移或波形质量下降时，也能够稳定地测定符号值。这种半导体集成电路含有：第一时钟信号发生电路，产生同步于输入时钟信号的N相位时钟信号；第二时钟信号发生电路，产生M相位时钟信号而且这些时钟信号同步于所选择的一个由第一时钟信号产生电路产生的N相位时钟信号，在此，N≠M；以及一个计算电路，用于求出一个控制值以从N相位时钟信号中选择一个相位，它根据串行传输数据的逻辑值，所述串行传输数据的采样利用N相位时钟信号和M相位时钟信号来进行。

A semiconductor integrated circuit which realizes a reception circuit that can stably detect symbol values even in a case where, in the reception of serial transmission data, the serial transmission data has its phase shifted relative to the sampling clock signals or has its waveform degraded due to the deviation of the delay of a signal in a transmission line. The semiconductor integrated circuit comprises a first clock-signal generating circuit which generates a clock signal of N phases synchronized with an input clock signal, a second clock-signal generating circuit which generates a clock signal of M phases synchronized with one phase selected from among the N-phase clock signal generated by the first clock-signal generating circuit, and in which N<>M holds, and a computation circuit which finds a control value for use in selecting one phase from among the N-phase clock signal, on the basis of the logic value of the serial transmission data sampled using the N-phase clock signal and the M-phase clock signal.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that is used to receive serially-transmitted data.

Background technology

Up to the present, with regard to the high speed serial transmission of digital signal (data), aspect the reception serially-transmitted data, typically use a kind of like this method, wherein utilize a sampled clock signal to come serially-transmitted data is sampled, the frequency of this sampled clock signal equals the bit rate of serially-transmitted data, and this sampled clock signal is synchronized with serially-transmitted data.

But, according to so simple method of sampling, when utilizing this sampled clock signal to come serially-transmitted data sampled, because the signal delay deviation in the transmission line, with respect to the phase place of sampled clock signal, phase shift (this phenomenon is referred to as " skew ") can appear in the phase place of serially-transmitted data, or descending can appear in the waveform quality of serially-transmitted data itself, thereby in some cases, can not measure value of symbol exactly.

Therefore, with regard to the receiving circuit that design is used for receiving the high speed serial transmission digital signal, even when receiving the serially-transmitted data that waveform quality descends, the circuit engineering that also can stably measure value of symbol has become extremely important.

In recent years, a kind of repeated sampling method has obtained using, even this method the method for value of symbol occurs also can effectively stably measuring under the situation that waveform quality descends as a kind of serially-transmitted data in transmission line, be to measure value of symbol with the principle that sampled point quantity is higher than the serially-transmitted data figure place.

For example, United States Patent (USP) 5,802,103 disclose an example of full-duplex transmission system, wherein utilize the repeated sampling method in the high speed serial transmission to measure the reception data.In file disclosed, under the situation of utilizing treble second mining quadrat method, even when the phase place of serially-transmitted data during with respect to the phase place generation phase shift of sampled clock signal, for symbol period (this is equivalent to the inverse that clock frequency multiply by a product that figure place obtained in the data block), can allow to be close to ± 30% phase shift.

Fig. 1 is a block diagram, has shown example that utilizes the receiving circuit of repeated sampling method in the prior art.In this example, the figure place in data block is 8, and sampling rate is three times of bit rate of serially-transmitted data.

As shown in Figure 1, this receiving circuit contains: PLL or DLL circuit 210, and it produces multi-phase clock signal according to input clock signal, and the sampling rate that multi-phase clock signal provides is three times of bit rate of serially-transmitted data; A sample register 220, it utilizes multi-phase clock signal to come serially-transmitted data is carried out repeated sampling; And a logical value decision circuit 230, it judges the 8 bit sign values that are included in the data block according to the result of repeated sampling.

The serially-transmitted data that is input to a data block (8) of sample register 220 is in 24 sampled points and carries out repeated sampling, three times of the quantity is-symbol figure place of sampled point, and the repeated sampling data are output with 24 parallel-by-bit data modes.

Logical value decision circuit 230 utilizes parallel data to carry out probability calculation, finds the transfer point of serially-transmitted data with this.In addition, logical value decision circuit 230 is carried out resampling also according to transfer point, and selected 8 suitable parallel-by-bit data are finally determined 8 bit sign values with this from the 24 parallel-by-bit data that repeated sampling obtained.

Fig. 2 is the schematic diagram from the angle explanation of logical value receiving circuit operation principle shown in Figure 1.Be input to a data block of the serially-transmitted data of receiving circuit, be carried out repeated sampling by multi-phase clock signal, the frequency of multi-phase clock signal is three times of bit rate of a data block of serially-transmitted data, thereby sampled data is output with the form of 24 parallel-by-bit data, and 24 parallel-by-bit data have reflected the logical value of serially-transmitted data.

Utilize parallel data to carry out probability calculation, can determine transfer point 201～205 with this.For example, when identical logical value is double in the sampling parallel data, just determined the existence of transfer point.Therefore on the basis of the transfer point of determining, can from 24 parallel-by-bit data, determine 8 bit sign values.

But according to this repeated sampling method, the quantity of sampling clock and the quantity of sample circuit can increase, thereby needed chip area also can increase with the consume electric current in semiconductor integrated circuit.Therefore, with regard to the semiconductor integrated circuit of repeated sampling method that three times, four times or higher multiple are adopted in design,, exist the problem that manufacturing cost rises though can solve this problem by adopting accurate semiconductor technology.

Summary of the invention

In view of the foregoing, the purpose of this invention is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, be used to realize receiving the receiving circuit of serially-transmitted data, this receiving circuit is when receiving serially-transmitted data, even serially-transmitted data because of transmission line in signal when deviation or delay occurring and phase shift or waveform quality occurring and descend with respect to sampled clock signal, also can stably measure value of symbol, and this receiving circuit can also be controlled the increase of sampled clock signal quantity and sample circuit quantity.

For realizing above-mentioned purpose, the present invention adopts following technical scheme:

Contain in the described a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of first technical scheme according to the present invention: first clock generating circuit is used to produce the N phase clock signal and makes these clock signals be synchronized with input clock signal; The second clock signal generating circuit is used to produce the M phase clock signal and makes these clock signals be synchronized with a selected N phase clock signal that is produced by first clock signal generating circuit, at this, and N ≠ M; And a counting circuit, being used for obtaining a controlling value to select a phase place from the N phase clock signal, it is according to the logical value of serially-transmitted data, and the sampling of described serially-transmitted data utilizes N phase clock signal and M phase clock signal to carry out.

In addition, contain in second described a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of technical scheme according to the present invention: first clock generating circuit is used to produce the N phase clock signal and makes these clock signals be synchronized with input clock signal; The second clock signal generating circuit is used to produce the M phase clock signal and makes these clock signals be synchronized with input clock signal; And counting circuit, be used to obtain controlling value to change the phase relation between N phase clock signal and the M phase clock signal, it is according to the logical value of serially-transmitted data, and the sampling of described serially-transmitted data utilizes N phase clock signal and M phase clock signal to carry out.

Semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention is applicable to the device such as LCD, and its feature is: utilize two groups of multi-phase clock signals, they are synchronized with input clock signal and umber of pulse difference, i.e. frequency difference in a chronomere.First group of multi-phase clock signal is used to measure the phase alignment of serially-transmitted data; And second group of multi-phase clock signal, the value of symbol that is used to measure the phase alignment of serially-transmitted data and is used to obtain serially-transmitted data.The phase place of second group of multi-phase clock signal utilizes the measurement result of phase alignment to adjust, and always is in the best with this phase place that can guarantee sampled clock signal with respect to the transmission data.

Therefore, when receiving serially-transmitted data, even serially-transmitted data because of transmission line in signal when deviation or delay occurring and phase shift or waveform quality occurring and descend with respect to sampled clock signal, also value of symbol can be stably measured, but also the increase of sampled clock signal quantity and sample circuit quantity can be controlled.

Embodiment

Fig. 3 is a block diagram, has shown a kind of structure of receiving circuit.This receiving circuit is that the principle according to the described a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of first embodiment of the invention realizes.In this embodiment, the figure place in data block is 8, and the phase place adjustment capability that realizes is equal to or higher than with the triple speed rate of the bit rate of serially-transmitted data and carries out the phase place adjustment capability that realized under the situation of repeated sampling.

This receiving circuit contains: a PLL or DLL circuit 10 are used for producing equiphase N phase clock signal at interval according to an input clock signal; The 2nd PLL or DLL circuit 20 are used to produce equiphase M phase clock signal at interval, and the M phase clock signal is synchronized with a phase place in the N phase place of N phase clock signal.The N phase clock signal is used to measure the phase alignment of serially-transmitted data; And the M phase clock signal, the value of symbol that is used to measure the phase alignment of serially-transmitted data and is used to obtain serially-transmitted data.In this embodiment, 7 phase clock signals are as the N phase clock signal, and 8 phase clock signals are as the M phase clock signal.

In addition, this receiving circuit also contains a sample register 30, it 14 (=N+M-1) sampled point is sampled to serially-transmitted data, these sampled points do not overlap between 7 phase clock signals and 8 phase clock signals.The serially-transmitted data that is input to sample register 30 is that bit rate is 1.75 times of parallel datas to the symbol figure place, is output thereby parallel data is a form with 14 sampled datas.

In addition, this receiving circuit also contains a calibration calculations circuit 40, and it utilizes 14 sampled datas being imported to carry out probability calculation.Finally determine 8 bit sign values, calibration phase shift value and transmission quality value with this.The calibration phase shift value is transported to the 2nd PLL or DLL circuit 20 from 40 outputs of calibration calculations circuit.

Fig. 4 is a schematic diagram, and the operation principle of receiving circuit shown in Figure 3 has been described from the angle of logical value.The serially-transmitted data of input is carried out sampling at first group of sampled point 11～17 and second group of sampled point 21～28, first group of sampled point 11～17th is divided into 7 equal portions with cycle (8) of a data block, and second group of sampled point 21～28th is divided into 8 equal portions with cycle of a data block, thereby sampled data is to be output with 14 form: i.e. sampled data 31,32a, 32b, 33a, 33b, 34a, 34b, 35,36a, 36b, 37a, 37b, 38a and 38b.

Calibration calculations circuit 40 shown in Figure 3 utilizes 14 sampled datas to calculate the phase-shift value that serially-transmitted data is left suitable phase alignment position.

Below, will introduce a kind of computational methods with example forms, calculate the phase-shift value that serially-transmitted data is left suitable phase alignment position.

At first, the value in the internal register 41～47 of calibration counting circuit is reset to " 0 ".Then, the calibration calculations circuit judges whether the logical value of sampled data 32a equals the logical value of sampled data 32b, if logical value is equal to each other, the calibration calculations circuit is stored in " 1 " in the internal register 42.Equally, the calibration calculations circuit judges whether the logical value of sampled data 33a equals the logical value of sampled data 33b, if logical value is equal to each other, the calibration calculations circuit is stored in " 1 " in the internal register 43.Equally, the calibration calculations circuit judges whether the logical value of sampled data 34a equals the logical value of sampled data 34b, if logical value is equal to each other, the calibration calculations circuit is stored in " 1 " in the internal register 44.

Another aspect, calibration calculations circuit judge whether the logical value of sampled data 36a equals the logical value of sampled data 36b, if logical value is equal to each other, the calibration calculations circuit is stored in "+1 " in the internal register 45.Equally, the calibration calculations circuit judges whether the logical value of sampled data 37a equals the logical value of sampled data 37b, if logical value is equal to each other, the calibration calculations circuit is stored in "+1 " in the internal register 46.Equally, the calibration calculations circuit judges whether the logical value of sampled data 38a equals the logical value of sampled data 38b, if logical value is equal to each other, the calibration calculations circuit is stored in "+1 " in the internal register 47.

By the value that is stored in respectively in the internal register 41～47 is sued for peace, promptly can calculate the calibration phase shift value, on behalf of serially-transmitted data, it leave the phase-shift phase of suitable phase alignment position.In serially-transmitted data is during in suitable phase alignment position, and the calibration phase shift value is " 0 ".In addition, by the absolute value that is stored in the value in the internal register 41～47 is respectively sued for peace, can calculate mass value, it is representing the quality of transmission line.Under the quality of transmission line was good situation, the transmission quality value became " 6 ".

Simultaneously, by at 21～28 pairs of values of symbol that serially-transmitted data is sampled and obtained of second group of sampled point, be that the form with detection signal is output, second group of sampled point 21～28th is divided into 8 equal portions with cycle of a data block.

Below, will introduce another kind of computational methods with example forms, calculate the phase-shift value that serially-transmitted data is left suitable phase alignment position.

Though in the example in front, storage all is " 0 ", " 1 " or "+1 " in each internal register 41～47, in this example, storage is " 0 " or " 1 " in each internal register 41～47.Be exactly that if the logical value of the sampled data of two comparisons is equal, so, the calibration calculations circuit is that " 1 " is stored in each internal register specifically.After this, the calibration calculations circuit carries out read group total: obtain the summation SUM1 that is stored in the value in the internal register 41～44 respectively and obtain the summation SUM2 that is stored in the value in the internal register 45～47 respectively, with obtain two and difference (SUM2-SUM1).Therefore, the calibration calculations circuit can calculate the calibration phase shift value, and on behalf of serially-transmitted data, it leave the phase-shift phase of suitable phase alignment position.

Fig. 5 is a schematic diagram, has illustrated that from the angle of logical value the operation principle under the situation of phase shift appears in according to the receiving circuit of present embodiment input serially-transmitted data with respect to sampled clock signal.This is one and the example that waveform quality descends occurs that the reason that waveform quality descends is that serially-transmitted data is different with the signal delay time between the clock signal in the transmission line.

The serial transmission signal of input is carried out sampling at first group of sampled point 11～17 and second group of sampled point 21～28, two groups of sampled points have a common sampled point, thereby sampled data is to be output with 14 form: i.e. sampled data 51,52a, 52b, 53a, 53b, 54a, 54b, 55,56a, 56b, 57a, 57b, 58a and 58b.

Because serially-transmitted data phase shift occurs with respect to the phase alignment of sampled clock signal, therefore, is stored in the summation of the value in the calibration calculations circuit internal register 41～47 respectively, promptly the calibration phase shift value is "+2 " rather than " 0 ".The phase place adjustment is to carry out by this way: according to the 2nd PLL that produces sampled clock signal or the calibration phase shift value of DLL circuit 20 (see figure 3)s, change a selected clock signal as reference phase from 7 phase clock signals of output.In addition, be stored in the summation of the absolute value of the value in the calibration calculations circuit internal register 41～47 respectively, promptly the transmission quality value is " 4 " rather than " 6 ".This shows that under the influence of factors such as transmission line descending appears in the quality that receives data.

Fig. 6 is a schematic diagram, the operation principle after the angle of logical value has illustrated phase shift adjustment shown in Figure 5.Because the calibration phase shift value that calculates among Fig. 5 is "+2 ", therefore, selected clock signal is by phase shift " 2 " in the 2nd PLL or DLL circuit 20 (see figure 3)s, thereby, provide the clock signal of sampled point 11 to be changed to the clock signal of sampled point 16 is provided, and internal register 41～47 is reset.Another kind method is, in the predetermined time cycle calibration phase shift value that calculates sued for peace and then obtains mean value, can determine selected clock signal well.

The serially-transmitted data of input is carried out sampling at the sampled point that rearranges, thereby sampled data is output with 14 form: i.e. sampled data 63a, 63b, 64a, 64b, 65,66a, 66b, 67a, 67b, 68a, 68b, 61,62a and 62b.After this, utilize the value that is stored in respectively in the internal register 41～47, calculate the calibration phase shift value once more.Because the benchmark sampled point is by phase shift " 2 ", therefore, the calibration phase shift value becomes " 0 " once more.In addition, the transmission quality value also is resumed and is " 6 ".

That crosses just as described previously is such, phase relation between serially-transmitted data and the sampled clock signal, always utilize the result of calculation of calibration calculations circuit to adjust, therefore, even signal waveform occurs under the situation of waveform quality decline (for example skew) in transmission line, also can be according to a spot of data sampling, detected symbol value stably.

Fig. 7 A has shown needed minimum number of samples, and in the method for sampling of utilizing N phase clock signal of the present invention and M phase clock signal the phase place adjusting range of serially-transmitted data.On the other hand, Fig. 7 B has shown needed minimum number of samples, and before utilizing the phase place adjusting range of serially-transmitted data in the X times of repeated sampling method of technical examples.Obviously, by two kinds of method of samplings relatively, under N≤M situation, when (M/N-1) less than 1/3 the time, the method applied in the present invention can be carried out comparatively accurate phase place adjustment, accuracy is higher than the treble second mining quadrat method that is adopted in the former technical examples.Point out in passing, also can determine adjusted value well under N＞M situation, and in this case, when (M/N-1) less than 1/3 the time, the method applied in the present invention also can be carried out comparatively accurate phase place adjustment, and accuracy is higher than the treble second mining quadrat method that is adopted in the technical examples formerly.

Fig. 8 is a schematic diagram, has illustrated that from the angle of logical value receiving circuit shown in Figure 3 input serially-transmitted data operation principle under the uneven phase shift situation occurs with respect to sampled clock signal.This is one and the example that waveform quality descends occurs, the reason that waveform quality descends be in the unbalanced line road in serially-transmitted data and the balanced transmission line different with the signal delay time between the clock signal signal delay time between two transmission lines different.

The serially-transmitted data of input is carried out sampling at first group of sampled point 11～17 and second group of sampled point 21～28, first group of sampled point 11～17th is divided into 7 equal portions with cycle (8) of a data block, and second group of sampled point 21～28th is divided into 8 equal portions with cycle of a data block, and second group of sampled point is a sampled point that is synchronized with in first group of sampled point, thereby sampled data is to be output with 14 form: i.e. sampled data 71,72a, 72b, 73a, 73b, 74a, 74b, 75,76a, 76b, 77a, 77b, 78a and 78b.

In Fig. 8, because the back of the serially-transmitted data of input phase shift occurs with respect to the phase place of sampled clock signal, therefore, calibration calculations circuit 40 (see figure 3)s are "+1 " rather than " 0 " according to the calibration phase shift value that 14 sampled datas calculated of input.According to the calibration phase shift value, change the 2nd PLL of generation sampled clock signal or the selection of the clock signal in DLL circuit 20 (see figure 3)s, with this, adjust phase alignment.

Fig. 9 is a schematic diagram, the operation principle after the angle of logical value has illustrated uneven phase shift adjustment shown in Figure 8.Because the calibration phase shift value that calculates is "+1 ", therefore from 7 phase clock signals that sampled point 11～17 is provided selected clock signal by phase shift " 1 ", like this, the clock signal of selection is changed to the clock signal that sampled point 17 is provided from the clock signal that sampled point 11 is provided.Another kind method is, in the predetermined time cycle calibration phase shift value that calculates added up to and then obtains mean value, can determine selected clock signal well.

The serially-transmitted data of input is carried out sampling at the sampled point that rearranges, thereby sampled data is to be output with 14 form: i.e. sampled data 82a, 82b, 83a, 83b, 84a, 84b, 85,86a, 86b, 87a, 87b, 88a and 88b.When utilizing sampled data to calculate the calibration phase shift value, because the phase place of sampled clock signal is by phase shift " 1 ", therefore, the calibration phase shift value becomes " 0 " once more.

Should be pointed out that in Fig. 9 the calibration phase shift value becomes " 0 ", still, the transmission quality value, promptly be stored in the value in the internal register 41～47 absolute value and number, be " 4 ", rather than " 6 " among Fig. 4 and Fig. 6.Different with the situation shown in Fig. 5, in Fig. 5, serially-transmitted data only occurs postponing with respect to the sampled clock signal in the balanced transmission line, and under situation shown in Figure 9, owing to the time of delay between two contained in balanced transmission line transmission lines is also different, therefore, the serially-transmitted data of reception has the lower waveform of quality, even under the situation that keeps phase alignment, the transmission quality value also can diminish.

Therefore according to present embodiment, by the value in the internal register that is stored in the calibration calculations circuit is sued for peace, just can know the correct direction of phase alignment, in addition, by the absolute value of the value in the internal register that is stored in the calibration calculations circuit is sued for peace, can also guarantee the transmission line quality.

With regard to general serial transmission circuit, the dynamic fluctuation of transmission line quality appears easily.In this case, if can utilize a kind of simple method to measure the quality of transmission line (degree that waveform quality descends), then allow to select a kind of and corresponding transmission method of transmission line quality.For example, descend with regard to the serious transmission line, come the transmission of the serially-transmitted data of control transmission circuit, realize the transmission of stable serially-transmitted data with this by reducing bit rate with regard to waveform quality.Equally, also can select a kind of and the corresponding method of reseptance of transmission line quality.For example, descend with regard to the serious transmission line, improve the first stage gain of amplifier or in receiving circuit, carry out wave shape equalization, realize the reception of stable serially-transmitted data with this with regard to waveform quality.

According to present embodiment, utilize the needed clock signal quantity still less of proportion second mining quadrat method, can realize that promptly the phase alignment ability is equal to or higher than the receiving circuit of repeated sampling technology in the past.Therefore, can under the lower situation of power consumption, realize that performance is equal to or higher than the circuit that adopts repeated sampling method receiving circuit.

In addition, though be difficult to realize the kinetic measurement of serially-transmitted data in the former repeated sampling method,, according to present embodiment, this but is easy to realize.Therefore, the quality that present embodiment can the dynamically adapting transmission line.

In the present embodiment, such example has been described.It utilizes PLL or DLL circuit to produce the N phase clock signal that is synchronized with input clock signal, and it utilizes PLL or DLL circuit to produce the M phase clock signal that is synchronized with a selected clock signal in the N phase clock signal.But even when using another circuit that can produce equiphase multi-phase clock signal at interval, the present invention also is to realize and is effectively same.In addition, with regard to the quantity of multi-phase clock signal, as long as N ≠ M, no matter what numerical value N and M use is, the present invention also is to realize and is effectively same.

Below, will describe the described a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of second embodiment of the invention.This embodiment applies the present invention to a kind of like this receiving circuit: it has 3 passages at the RGB data image signal.In this embodiment, the figure place in data block is 10, and the phase alignment ability that this technology provided is equal to or higher than the phase alignment ability of 4 times of repeated sampling technology.

Figure 10 is a block diagram, has shown a kind of structure of receiving circuit, and this receiving circuit is that the principle according to the described a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit of second embodiment of the invention realizes.

This receiving circuit contains: a public circuit piece 100C; A R channel circuit piece 100R; A G channel circuit piece 100G; And B channel circuit piece 100B.

The balance clock signal of an input and the balance serially-transmitted data of three passages are amplified by differential amplifier 90～93 respectively.Each amplifier in the differential amplifier 90～93 all possesses the function of adjusting its stage gain just according to control signal, and control signal is provided by control circuit 50.In a DLL circuit 110, the balance clock signal of amplification is converted into 9 phase alignments and measures clock signal, and the calibration measurement clock signal has equal phase intervals and is synchronized with the balance clock signal of input.

Select from 9 phase clock signals that a DLL circuit 110 is exported, to select a clock signal in the circuit 70 in the clock signal of being controlled by phase alignment circuit 60.The 2nd DLL circuit 120 according to selected clock signal, is exported 10 phase symbol sampled clock signals, and 10 phase symbol sampled clock signals are synchronized with the balance clock signal of input.

In local buffer 80, accept 9 phase clock signals of waveform shaping and 10 phase clock signals of the 2nd DLL circuit 120 outputs, be imported into sample circuit 130.Sample circuit 130 according to the clock signal of input, is sampled to the serially-transmitted data that differential amplifier 91 amplifies, with the (=10+9-1) sampled data of position of exporting 18.

Phase alignment circuit 60 according to 18 sampled data, obtains the calibration phase shift value, and this value is being represented the information of relevant serially-transmitted data phase alignment, and phase alignment circuit 60 returns to clock signal selection circuit 70 with this calibration phase shift value.

Simultaneously, phase alignment circuit 60 is obtained the transmission quality value also according to 18 sampled data, and this value is being represented the transmission quality of relevant serially-transmitted data, and phase alignment circuit 60 returns to control circuit 50 with this transmission quality value.Control circuit 50 according to the transmission quality value of 3 passages, is determined the first stage gain of differential amplifier 90～93, so just can carry out and the corresponding to gain adjustment of serially-transmitted data transmission quality.

Another aspect, 10 bit data that the sampled clock signal that utilizes the 2nd DLL circuit 120 to export samples will be carried out a position correction by word calibration circuit 90, and after this, sampled data is output with the form of parallel data.

Though the front is that the R channel circuit piece in R, G, the B triple channel circuit block is had been described in detail,, each passage in all the other 2 passages also all is made up of similar circuit block.Therefore,, with respect to clock signal independently phase delay is arranged, also can realize transmitting the stable reception of data even work as the serially-transmitted data of 3 passages by utilizing receiving system according to present embodiment.
